name: Hex Architecture Refactoring
description: Refactor forward-mcp to use hex layered architecture with domain, ports, usecases, and adapters

phases.name: Extract Domain Layer
phases.description: Create domain entities and services with no external dependencies

tasks.title: Create internal/domain/entities package
tasks.description: Extract core domain models: Query, Result, Network, Snapshot, etc.

tasks.title: Create internal/domain/services package
tasks.description: Extract domain services: query validation, result processing, caching rules

phases.name: Define Port Interfaces
phases.description: Create interfaces defining how domain interacts with outside world

tasks.title: Create CachePort interface
tasks.description: Define cache operations: Get, Set, Delete, Clear, GetSimilar

tasks.title: Create DatabasePort interface
tasks.description: Define database operations: Query, Insert, Update, Delete

tasks.title: Create APIClientPort interface
tasks.description: Define Forward API client operations: GetNetworks, Query, GetSnapshot

tasks.title: Create MemoryPort interface
tasks.description: Define knowledge graph operations: AddEntity, AddRelation, Query

phases.name: Implement Adapters
phases.description: Move existing implementations to adapter packages

tasks.title: Create cache adapter
tasks.description: Move semantic_cache.go and bloom_search.go to adapters/cache/

tasks.title: Create database adapter
tasks.description: Move nqe_db.go and nqe_query_index.go to adapters/database/

phases.name: Create Use Cases
phases.description: Refactor services to use ports instead of concrete implementations

tasks.title: Refactor mcp_service.go
tasks.description: Update MCP service to inject ports and call use cases

tasks.title: Update tool handlers
tasks.description: Update tools.go to use port-based services

tasks.title: Run unit tests
tasks.description: Run go test to verify no regressions

tasks.title: Run build check
tasks.description: Run go build to verify compilation
